name: Inferior Focus of Earth
productEffect: An extremely heavy stone-like object that is reminiscent of a miniature mountain, this rock appears to contain many different minerals and substances.  This item is humming like the Altar of Invasion.

name: Inferior Focus of Air
productEffect: Like a flighty, swirling, miniature tornado, this object sounds like the wind and is very difficult to hold onto.  This item is humming like the Altar of Invasion.

name: Inferior Focus of Fire
productEffect: Alternating between pleasantly warm and hot enough to burn, this object is like an inextinguishable flame that pops and crackles occasionally.  This item is humming like the Altar of Invasion.

name: Inferior Focus of Water
productEffect: A swirling, dynamic, miniature whirlpool, this object has a lot of power and inertia and seems to resist being moved around.  This item is humming like the Altar of Invasion.

name: Inferior Focus of Positive Energy
productEffect: This bright, heavenly point of light is almost too bright to look at, but is easy to hold and exudes a wonderfully pleasant, uplifting energy.  This item is humming like the Altar of Invasion.

name: Inferior Focus of Negative Energy
productEffect: This small, inky miasma seems to drip with negativity.  If you look too long at the center, you begin to feel slightly sick.  This item is humming like the Altar of Invasion.

name: Diluted Material Essence
productEffect: This roughly spherical, dark gray lump of matter takes on the rough impression of any object that brushes close by.  This item is humming like the Altar of Invasion.

name: Diluted Ethereal Essence
productEffect: An amorphous, hazy, cloud-like thing with tendrils and wisps that are constantly moving about.  If you try to study the object closely, you find you can no longer maintain your concentration and must shift your focus.  This item is humming like the Altar of Invasion.

name: Cloudy Gem of Dominion
productEffect: This smoothly polished gem is a swirling crimson color and has a glistening black star in the center.  Tightly grasping this gem makes you feel powerful and confident.  This item is humming like the Altar of Invasion.

name: Cloudy Gem of Opposition
productEffect: This smoothly polished gem is a pale blue color and has a silvery star in the center.  Tightly grasping this gem makes you feel stalwart and resolute.  This item is humming like the Altar of Invasion.

name: Cloudy Gem of Escalation
productEffect: This smoothly polished gem is yellow in color but occasionally glints with bright orange and has a fiery star in the center.  Tightly grasping this gem fills you with ambition and makes you feel rather light-headed.  This item is humming like the Altar of Invasion.
